title: Solo dev, AI-assisted: I'm building a card game with six regions and 30 champions. Here's what's working so far
author: Acceptable_Army_5576
selftext:
I've loved card games since Hearthstone, and I always wanted to make one. I'm doing it alone, using AI for the art and to help write the code, while I direct the design and decisions.



What exists now: 252 cards across six regions, champions that level up mid match, four starter decks, a tutorial, a story journey on a world map, and matches against an AI or a friend. Planned: a roguelike mode, more story and a ranked system.



What worked: AI art for champions at two levels, and AI help for building features fast. What was hard: keeping the art style consistent and catching bugs the AI introduced.



If you're building with AI too, I'd like to hear your workflow. And if you want to test the game, join my Discord and I'll send you the link there: [https://discord.gg/NYZzt6nbkA](https://discord.gg/NYZzt6nbkA)
